clue.text: Family doctor, popular person who's most important

in means fashionable or popular

explanation.definitionFit: A kingpin is the central figure in an organisation, the one on whom everything else depends.

clue.text: Captain releasing small fish

parts.note: a skipper is the captain of a ship or team

explanation.surface: A ship's captain lets a tiny fish go back into the water.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Small fish' reads as one phrase; small is the letter to drop and fish alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A kipper is a split, salted and smoked herring, a fish familiar at British breakfast tables.

clue.text: Relative conclusions of Einstein accurate? What a relief

parts.note: last letters of Einstein and accurate
phew is the exclamation of relief

explanation.surface: Relief that Einstein's relativity conclusions proved accurate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Relative' playfully suggests relativity and Einstein, but here it means a family member.
explanation.definitionFit: A nephew is the son of one's brother or sister, so he is a kind of family member.

explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue, 'upset' fits a reversal well: the word is literally turned upside down.
explanation.definitionFit: A press conference is an event where someone answers questions put by reporters, a meeting held for journalists.

clue.text: Retreat certainly not all right

clue.text: Own son breaking model steamship

clue.text: Playing solo, hippy capturing hearts with outlook

parts.note: taken as written, for rearranging

clue.text: Having many options impaired intensity, group of singers mostly admitted

explanation.definitionFit: Spoilt for choice is an idiom for having so many alternatives that deciding becomes hard.

clue.text: Ecstatic about electronic volume being raised

parts.note: elated means ecstatic

clue.text: Note king in decline after start of scene in ballet

clue.text: Pioneer prepared to accept very soft pizza topping

explanation.walkthrough: pp, short for pianissimo, is the musical marking crosswords use for very soft.

clue.text: Letter for example retained by old mother

parts.note: O is the abbreviation for old

e.g. is the abbreviation for 'for example'

explanation.surface: An elderly mother keeps hold of a sample letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Omega is the last letter of the Greek alphabet, so it is one example of a letter.

clue.text: Service, apart from last quarter, all the same

explanation.walkthrough: EVENSONG has eight letters, so its last quarter is NG; removing that leaves EVEN SO.
explanation.definitionFit: Even so and all the same are both concessive phrases meaning nevertheless or despite that.

clue.text: Start moving occasion with procedure to establish attendance

parts.note: to roll is to get under way, as in 'cameras, roll'
call means occasion or need, as in 'there was no call for that'

explanation.definitionFit: A roll call reads out a list of names so that each person present can answer, recording attendance.

clue.text: Poor soul consumed by duty is working diligently

parts.note: taken as written, for rearranging

parts.note: taken as written, for rearranging

explanation.walkthrough: There are two separate anagrams: one of soul, placed inside one of duty is.
explanation.definitionFit: Studiously means with careful, painstaking attention, so it matches diligently as an adverb.

clue.text: One demanding power in wild talk for once receiving resistance

parts.note: taken as written, for rearranging

explanation.definitionFit: A control freak is someone who insists on dictating everything, an obsessive need to be in charge.

clue.text: Candidate with dodgy past going round nation

explanation.definitionFit: An aspirant is someone seeking a position or honour, so in noun form it is an applicant or candidate.

clue.text: Franchise hurt, losing energy over time

clue.text: Pompous person, with material beginning to expose scandal, keeping quiet

sh is the call for quiet

clue.text: Scoff after United lead, being optimistic

clue.text: Run away from church and cheat

parts.note: to flee is to run away from

clue.text: Substandard data about terrain omitting odd features? Right

explanation.walkthrough: 'Odd features' looks like strange landmarks, but it means the odd-numbered letters.

clue.text: Man felt free from boundaries in place of worship

parts.note: the inner letters of felt

explanation.definitionFit: A chapel is a small church or a room set aside for prayer, a kind of building for worship.

clue.text: Boat in sea initially north of Guernsey?

clue.text: Once more in Narnia, gather round

clue.text: Profanity? Wise to restrain cold anger

clue.text: Be revolutionary in speculation, losing nothing as a result of that

indicators.note: in places one piece inside another
losing something means it is taken away from the word

parts.note: a theory is a speculation

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Be radical in your theorising, and you may lose everything as a consequence.

explanation.definitionFit: Thereby is a formal adverb meaning by that means or in consequence of that.
